nodes.text: The human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is tearing through the country, causing chaos in hospitals and leaving crematoriums overflowing with corpses. Multiple viruses, including influenza A, HMPV, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Covid-19 are currently circulating in China.
